plainTranslation: Composite Pluto in the 12 House: With Composite Pluto in the 12th house, you may struggle over power and control in ways that aren’t obvious. It can be in a subconscious way, and you may want to have all of the power and control. This position can show one person makes all of the sacrifices and the other person takes everything selfishly, so you need to make sure you’re both giving and taking equally. You can transform together in meaningful ways if you can steer clear of secrets, lies, and cruelty.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
note: Imported from The Dark Pixie Astrology composites material text.
